current_source_evidence.calibrated_source: Verified Native ADC Float32, FRange applied exactly once
current_source_evidence.one_global_adc_existing: self.adc; extra_adc and dsp_adc must be removed from visible UI
current_source_evidence.original_data_rule: AUX4700 scalars cannot generate FFT/time waveform

initial_intended_ui_preset.x_range: 0..min(1000 Hz, physical Nyquist), or last valid operator preset
initial_intended_ui_preset.fft_n: current 32768; planned auto bounded by verified samples
initial_intended_ui_preset.markers: off unless real evidence or known RPM

rules: FFT=one-sided coherent-gain-calibrated Hann RMS per spectral line; not PSD
Welch PSD=power per Hz; integrate PSD*df for RMS squared in valid band
ASD=sqrt(PSD), different unit, not FFT RMS
dB amplitude and ASD use 20log10(value/reference), PSD uses 10log10(power/reference_power)
dB plot uses ordinary linear Y axis with numeric dB values, not second logarithm
frequency_log_x minimum strictly positive; exclude DC
Nyquist bound Fs/2 never exceeded; Fs comes only from Native
manual_axis preserved across new FFT frames until explicit reset
peak locations and spectral integrals always use full-resolution data, never downsampled plot
theoretical markers are dashed and distinct from measured peaks
no diagnosis based on single peak
Wave Y is signed instantaneous m/s2; do not label as spectral RMS
Auto Y symmetric around 0 with headroom, preserve negative peaks
Actual source duration shown if shorter than requested visible span
No assumed UTC when only capture counter is known
Filtered time and filtered spectrum remain independent unless user explicitly links
Display decimation preserves min and max, statistics use full physical window
Freeze display does not stop Native recording

plot_state.on_new_frame: update rendered series without resetting user zoom
plot_state.on_adc_change: invalidate incompatible physical Y and clamp X to current Nyquist with explicit message
plot_state.on_invalid_input: empty plot + reason; no synthetic zeros
plot_state.graph_overview_vs_detailed: two distinct view widgets sharing immutable result model

style.theme_mode: system_by_default; user can select graphite_dark / cloud_light
style.typography: system Segoe UI or Segoe UI Variable, fallback to native UI font
style.targets: controls min 30-36 logical px high; top action bar 40-44 logical px
style.chart_trace_px: 1-1.5 logical px subject to performance benchmark
style.focus: clear accessible keyboard focus; labels not color-only

routing.graph_click: focus one inspector without running DSP
routing.graph_expand: main Spectrum/Time detail tab; not W-method window
routing.advanced_method: open independent W01-W43 window with immutable verified source
routing.plot_save_source: NPZ V1 existing, sidecar settings later, no raw overwrite

dependencies.build: PySide6 QMainWindow + QDockWidget + QSplitter + QPalette/QSS + pyqtgraph
